findings.passage: I support the Second Amendment and the rights of responsible, law-abiding gun owners. I also believe those rights come with a responsibility to protect our children, families, and communities from preventable violence.I support universal background checks for firearm sales, closing loopholes that allow prohibited individuals to obtain weapons, and keeping guns away from violent felons, domestic abusers, and people who have been found by a court to present an immediate danger to others/themselves
findings.note: His answer on the voter-guide question 'What restrictions on gun ownership are needed to protect public safety?'. Copied as printed, including the missing space after 'violence.'; the text ends there on the page. No exact date shown; 2026 general-election guide.
